name: DROWL Admin Dashboard
description: Provides an administrative dashboard as helpful overview and entry point for site maintainers.

suggests.npm-asset/drowl-admin-iconset: Required to use drupal/drowl_admin_dashboard. Expected version: ^1.0

project_description:
Provides a central administrative overview for users with "Access Admin Dashboard" permission.

 Get a nice dashboard for your Drupal project and provide a better onboarding experience for your site managers.

 Back to top 

 Versions 
 
 4.x is based on 3.x, see below! It uses Drupals new "Navigation" module instead of Administration Toolbar that was needed in 3.x 
 3.x is more or less hard-coded and simple. It uses a Twig template plus twig_tweak. Remember to uninstall page manager or remove the page variant, when upgrading from 2.x! 
 2.x was based on
 
 page_manager + [#2960739] 
 layout_builder 
 
 but page_manager is not very well maintained anymore and layout_builder might become obsolete due to Drupal Canvas, so we decided for a more hard-coded approach using a Twig template plus twig_tweak in 3.x
